getHealth.reason: Ops liveness probe; no person-facing screen.

getResource.reason: Resource information and contact actions live in the catalog cards; the detail operation is API-only for v1 web (owner Q1, 2026-11-13).

getImmediateResources.reason: The web app shows the compiled SAFETY_COPY crisis text (SURFACES §6 fallback); only legacy /app reads this slot.

putNotificationPreferences.reason: Notification preferences have no GET, so the web app has no settings for them in v1; legacy /app only.

getAdminAdapterConfigurations.reason: Adapter configuration needs a tenant_id the web app cannot learn; provider adapters are read-only in v1.

enableAdminAdapterConfiguration.reason: Adapter configuration needs a tenant_id the web app cannot learn; provider adapters are read-only in v1.

disableAdminAdapterConfiguration.reason: Adapter configuration needs a tenant_id the web app cannot learn; provider adapters are read-only in v1.

setAdminAdapterRouting.reason: Adapter configuration needs a tenant_id the web app cannot learn; provider adapters are read-only in v1.

openCase.reason: Creating a request reuses the case server-side; the web app never opens a case itself.

createCaseServiceRequest.reason: The helper 'add a need' action was dropped; requests are created by the Veteran.

listCaseFollowUps.reason: Follow-Ups are outside R11.1: FOLLOWUP.md is draft and its v1 USER responsible type is not released, so the v1 web has no Follow-Up surface.

createFollowUp.reason: Follow-Ups are outside R11.1: FOLLOWUP.md is draft and its v1 USER responsible type is not released, so the v1 web has no Follow-Up surface.

completeFollowUp.reason: Follow-Ups are outside R11.1: FOLLOWUP.md is draft and its v1 USER responsible type is not released, so the v1 web has no Follow-Up surface.

listCaseSettlements.reason: The resolve response returns the Settlement; CASES.md §8.1 allows a Veteran view but does not require one, and no v1 screen shows past Settlements.

getCaseSettlement.reason: The resolve response returns the Settlement; CASES.md §8.1 allows a Veteran view but does not require one, and no v1 screen shows past Settlements.

triageCase.reason: SUAS-admin case command; the admin cannot read or list cases in v1, so there is no admin case screen.
triageCase.ref: suas-specs v0.10.0 CASES.md §8; R12.5; plan O4(a); R13.2 (proposal)

moveCaseToFollowup.reason: R11.1 grants the move, but it needs a Follow-Up or a documented reason and Follow-Ups are outside R11.1; the web resolves from ACTIVE.
moveCaseToFollowup.ref: suas-specs v0.10.0 CASES.md §4, FOLLOWUP.md §3 (draft), R11.1; R13.2 (proposal)

resumeCaseActive.reason: The web never moves a Case to FOLLOWUP, so there is nothing to resume; D-046 (not released) would remove the command.
resumeCaseActive.ref: suas-specs v0.10.0 CASES.md §4, R11.1, D-046 (unreleased); R13.2 (proposal)

escalateCase.reason: No escalation reader in v1: there is no admin Case list or read and no RED queue, so the button would promise a review nobody performs.

reopenCase.reason: SUAS-admin case command; the admin cannot read or list cases in v1, so there is no admin case screen.
reopenCase.ref: suas-specs v0.10.0 CASES.md §8, D-046 (unreleased); R12.5; plan O4(a); R13.2 (proposal)
